integrity.archival_source_date: arXiv:0910.5028 was first publicly submitted 2009-10-27, carrying primary MSC 14M25.
integrity.certificate: artifacts/index_depth_profile.csv is regenerated and compared byte for byte by artifacts/verify.py using standard-library exact arithmetic.
integrity.finite_enumeration_basis: All q from 2 through 65 and all p with 1<=p<q and gcd(p,q)=1 are enumerated; every chart is generated from the exact two-dimensional tangent-cone fan.
integrity.finite_vs_infinite: Only an exact finite-domain classification is asserted; apparent logarithmic behavior beyond index 65 is unproved.
integrity.proof_dependency: arXiv:0910.5028, Section 4, Propositions 4.10–4.14: exact surface Hilbert basis, Nash-normalization fan and termination.

scientific_limitations: The exact depth formula and maximizer classification are proved only for cyclic determinant indices 2 through 65.
The affine toric surface Nash fan construction and resolution termination theorem are preexisting results of Atanasov et al.; only the finite sharp depth profile is newly claimed.
The parameter count 1307 refers to primitive representative pairs and may count integrally equivalent cones more than once.
The checker is an exhaustive arithmetic proof over a finite set, with no independent review; unindexed previously computed tables remain a possible originality risk.
title: Sharp finite normalized Nash-depth profile for surface cones of index at most 65
